name: Esri World Imagery
description: Esri World Imagery as an aerial basemap: aerial photos at about 0.3 to 1 m per pixel in most cities, sharp enough to see lanes, kerbs and track. Offered once an Admin saves an ArcGIS API key and accepts Esri's terms under Administration → Plugins; the tiles come through this MobSimLab, so browsers never see the key, and are not stored.

basemaps.label: Esri World Imagery
basemaps.note: Aerial photos at about 0.3 to 1 m per pixel in most cities, coarser in the countryside: sharp enough to see lanes, kerbs and track. Photo dates vary by place.
